title: Independent Pane Cameras In Board Play
description: Board play: stop synchronizing all three pane cameras on wheel sync, redraw play chase, post-play ease, and nodes-redraw ease. Only the active pane updates toward bbox / viewport; other panes keep their own baseline. Play start preserves per-pane cameras (no triptych reset).
summary: Per-pane cameras in board play: viewport sync updates only the active pane baseline; redraw play start preserves all three panes; chase damps only the active pane toward bbox fit; post-play and nodes-redraw camera eases blend only the active pane toward triptych while other panes stay on their prior cameras. Removed unused blendTriptychCameras and dampTriptychCamerasLinear. Vitest 65 passed.
